spans.s:
r. 4th cl. (इर, उ) इरदमु (दम्यति)
1 To tame or subject as an enemy, to quiet or pacify, to tranquillize.
2 To be tamed or tranquillized.

m. (-मः)
1 Punishing, chastisement, punishment.
2 Taming, subduing.
3 Self-command, endurance of the most painful austerities.
4 Self-restraint, subduing the senses, suppressing the appetites, passions, &c.
5 Mud, mire.
6 (In the Vedas,) The hall of sacrifice.
E.
दम to tame or subdue, affix अक्ष्.

f. (-मा)
A rope, a string, a cord.
E.
see दामन्.

ind.
A wife.
E.
दम to subject, affix क्विप्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
A tamer, a subduer.
E.
दम to tame, affix ण्वुल्.

m. (-षः)
A prince of the lunar race, king of Cedi, father of ŚIŚUPĀLA.

m. (-तः)
A name of ŚIŚUPĀLA, a king and enemy of KṚṢṆA.
E.
दमघोष a proper name, the father of ŚIŚUPĀLA, and सुत a son.

mn. (-थः-थं)
1 Punishment, punishing, chastising.
2 Selfcontrol, endurance of rigorous austerities.
n. (-थं)
Taming, subduing.
E.
दम to tame or subdue, Uṇādi affix अथ.

mn. (-थुः)
1 Punishment, restraint or subjection of others.
2 Self-denial, subjection of oneself.
E.
दम to tame, अथुच् aff.

m. (-नः)
1 A hero.
2 A philosopher.
3 A kind of flower, commonly Dona, (Artemisia.)
n. (-नं)
Taming, subduing.
E.
दम to tame, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Relating to the Dona or Artemisia flower.
E.
दामन, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be tamed, subjected, or subdued.
E.
दम to tame, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Taming, restraining, chastising.
f. (-न्ती)
1 The wife of

NALA.
2

A kind of cucumber.
E.
दम to subdue, participial affix शतृ.

f. (-सा)
DAMAYANTĪ.
E.
द्रम, खसृ sister of.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Tamed, subdued, patient of every suffering, exaction or privation.
E.
दम to tame, affix क्त, with इट् inserted.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
A tamer, a dominator.
E.
दम with धिनुण् aff.

m. (-नाः)
1 A name of Agni or fire.
2 A name of ŚUKRA, regent of Venus.
E.
दम to tame (all things), Uṇādi affix उनसि; also ऊनसि, whence दमुनस्, m. (-नाः.)

m. du. (-ती)
Husband and wife.
E.
दम् a wife, and पति a husband.

r. 5th cl. (उ) दम्भु (दभ्नोति)
1 To act deceitfully, to cheat, to impose upon, to trick or deceive.
2 To split or divide.
r. 10th cl. (दम्भयति)
To collect, to gather, to arrange or string.

m. (-म्भः)
1 Deceit, fraud, cheating.
2

Hypocrisy.
3

Sin, wickedness.
4 Arrogance, pride.
E.
दम्भ to deceive, &c. affix घञ्.

mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि)
1

Hypocritical.
2

Proud.
3

Wicked.
m. (-म्भी)
A hypocrite, an impostor.
E.
दम्भ, and इनि aff.

m. (-लिः)
INDRA'S thunderbolt.
E.
दम्भ to divide or split, affix उलि.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
To be subjected or tamed.
2 To be punished.
m. (-भ्यः)
A steer, a young bullock.
E.
दम to tame, यत् affix.

nf. (-म-मा)
A string, a cord, a thread or rope.
E.
दो to cut or divide, &c. affix मनिन्.

n. (-र्व्व)
The fourteenth of the light half of Chaitra, when the Dona flower is worshipped.
E.
दामन, and पर्व्व a holiday.

f. (-नी)
A string, a rope, especially for typing cattle.
E.
दामन् as above, अण् and ङीष् affs.

n. (-प्तं)
A country, the modern district of Tumlook.
E.
see तामलिप्त, त being changed to द.

n. (-नं)
A foot-rope for horses, &c.
E.
दामा, and अञ्ज to go, affix ल्युट्; also दामा, and अञ्चल end, दामाञ्चल, n. (-लं.)

m. (-रः)
1 A name of KṚṢṆ

A Jina of the past age.
E.
दाम a rope, and उदर a belly; YAŚODHĀ his foster mother having in vain passed the folds of a rope round his body, whilst a child, to keep him in confinement.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Hypocritical.
m. (-कः)
A hypocrite.
2 A kind of crane, (Ardea nivea.)
E.
दम्भ, and टक् aff.
